name: Levelling 1-60: zone route
summary: You level by questing, running dungeons, killing mobs near your level and exploring, with Rested XP and Well Fed food buffs speeding things up. Follow each zone's minimum level for the smoothest route.
route: 1: Elwynn Forest, Dun Morogh, Teldrassil, Zephras Isle (Skyborne), Durotar, Mulgore, Tirisfal Glades
10: Westfall, Loch Modan, Darkshore, The Barrens, Silverpine Forest
30: Alterac Mountains, Arathi Highlands, Desolace, Stranglethorn Vale
35: Badlands, Dustwallow Marsh, Feralas, Riverglades (new), Swamp of Sorrows
tips: Quest and fight near your level for the best XP
Keep a cooked-food Well Fed buff up: it now boosts XP
Log out in inns or cities for Rested XP
Visit class, weapon and riding trainers as you level
Dungeon enemies now give more XP

name: Warrior levelling
summary: All three specs can level: Arms is the classic pick for burst, Fury hits hard but takes more damage, and Protection can AoE packs with little health loss.
talents: Arms: Deflection and Anger Management, skip Spearing Strike to max Two-Handed Weapon Specialization, then Bloodthrill (preferred) or Weaponmaster.
rotation: Rend if the mob will live a few ticks
Heroic Strike with leftover Rage (or Slam with Improved Slam)
keyGear: Whirlwind Axe / Sword / Warhammer: level 30 class quest
Brutal Hauberk or Fire Hardened Hauberk: level 20 class quest
Slow, heavy two-handers boost Whirlwind and Mortal Strike
Blacksmithing BoP gear
Health potions (now craftable with First Aid)
tips: Plan stance swaps so you don't waste Rage
Save some Rage from Execute for the next mob
Use Intimidating Shout, Retaliation and Shield Wall freely to pull more
Whirlwind is great for levelling in any spec
Blacksmithing + Mining

name: Hunter levelling
summary: Strong levellers thanks to pets, ranged damage and crowd control, though the first levels are slow. Beast Mastery is the smoothest; Marksmanship and Survival also work.
talents: From level 10: Beast Mastery for pet damage and survival (Bestial Swiftness, Ferocity); Legacy points add Intimidation and Frenzy early.
rotation: Send the pet in while Auto Shooting
Summon Hawk on cooldown, Arcane Shot with two Hawks up
Aimed Shot and Rapid Fire on cooldown
If the pet loses aggro: Wing Clip, Concussive Shot or Frost Trap
keyGear: Barbaric Crossbow: Ragefire Chasm (13-16)
Calibrated Blunderbuss: Hall of Thanes quest, Alliance (13-16)
Venomstrike: Wailing Caverns (19-22)
Fallenroot Longbow: Blackfathom Deeps (23-29)
Master Hunter's Bow: Big Game Hunter quest (30)
tips: Summon pets at a campfire to give them Camping buffs
Feign Death to skip fights
Cheetah for travel, but getting hit dazes you
Pick up Skinning or Herbalism while you travel

name: Mage levelling
summary: Frost is the traditional levelling spec; Arcane and Fire work but lean on procs or dungeon groups.
talents: From level 10. Frost: 7 points in Arcane for early Missile Barrage, then Ice Lance and Fingers of Frost. Arcane: rush Missile Barrage. Fire: Ignite, Incineration, Pyroblast.
rotation: Frostbolt as main spell (Rank 1 early to fish for Missile Barrage)
Ice Lance on frozen targets or Fingers of Frost
No procs: Frost Nova then Ice Lance
Packs: Frost Nova into Flamestrike and Arcane Explosion, or Blizzard
keyGear: Staff of Westfall: Deadmines
Nightskulker Ring: dungeons
Novice Arcanist's Sash and Spidersilk Boots: Tailoring
Manaweave Robe (Alliance) / Spellfire Robe (Horde): level 15 class quest
tips: Conjure a full stack of food and water between pulls
Use Lesser Wizard Oil for hard quests
Always keep mana for Blink and Frost Nova
Expect lots of drinking until Mage Armor at 34
Tailoring + Enchanting

name: Paladin levelling
summary: Slow but very safe: keep a Seal up and alternate Judgement and Holy Strike. Retribution, Protection or a Holy/Ret 'Shockadin' hybrid all work.
talents: Mostly Retribution for the first 20-30 levels, starting at 10; the mid-level build uses 26 points, optionally skipping one 5th-row point for Repentance.
rotation: Seal of Command (Righteousness below 20 or with a one-hander)
Repeat Judgement and Holy Strike on cooldown
keyGear: Verigan's Fist: The Test of Righteousness (20)
Moonsilver Blade: The Moonsilver Blade (20)
Wolfsbane: Old Fire Eye quest
Cloak of the Divine Storm: Must be Delgren (22)
Bastion of Stormwind: Tome of Valor (20)
tips: Blacksmithing + Mining for spell power gear
Heal with Holy Light, using Divine Protection first if needed
Slow heavy weapons for Ret, fast ones for Protection's Seal of Fury
Greater Blessings aren't needed until raiding

name: Priest levelling
summary: Comfortable levelling by shielding, dotting and wanding. At 30 you settle into Discipline, Holy or (fastest) Shadow.
talents: Builds are image-only on the source; the Legacy 'Talented' perk unlocks talents up to 5 levels early. Holy is not recommended for levelling (slow kills).
rotation: Power Word: Shield when mana allows
Discipline 30+: Penance for damage or healing
keyGear: Lesser Magic Wand (5) and Greater Magic Wand (13): Enchanting
Sizzle Stick: Wailing Caverns quest (15)
Gravestone Scepter: Blackfathom Deeps quest (18)
Wand of Eventide: world drop (27)
tips: Keep Power Word: Fortitude up
Spirit cuts drinking time
Shadow needs spell power to shine before 28

name: Rogue levelling
summary: Rogues got better Energy, stronger poisons and talent overhauls in every tree, with four levelling builds to choose from.
talents: From level 10 pick Assassination, Combat, Subtlety Ambush or Subtlety Bleed; e.g. Remorseless Attacks at 10 (Assassination), Hack and Slash at 30 (Combat).
rotation: Backstab from Stealth with a dagger to burst
Only stealth for tough mobs: it slows levelling
keyGear: Shadowfang: Shadowfang Keep
Nightskulker Ring and Tunic of Westfall: dungeons
Dark Leather Boots and Brawler's Leather Belt: Leatherworking
tips: Skinning + Leatherworking
Poisons now stack with sharpening stones and Windfury Totem
Spend combo points before switching targets

name: Shaman levelling
summary: Great group assets with totems and Improved Ghost Wolf mobility. Enhancement is the smoothest levelling spec.
talents: Separate Elemental, Enhancement and Restoration mid-level builds (to 30 with Legacy points, 35 without).
rotation: Lightning Shield, Windfury Weapon, Searing and Strength of Earth totems
Earth Shock filler; spend Maelstrom at 5 stacks
keyGear: Rage of the Storm / Lightning's Grasp / Tidebringer's Claw: level 30 Call of Air chain
Polished Driftwood Icon: Enchanting (BoP)
Totem of Charged Flames: Meddlesome Mages quest (Skyborne)
tips: Only drop totems you need
Earthbind to kite, Stoneclaw to pull aggro off you
Take Improved Ghost Wolf for instant indoor travel
Carry ankhs unless a Legacy talent removes reagents

name: Warlock levelling
summary: Affliction is the easiest start: let your demon tank while DoTs do the work, Life Tap and Drain Life for near-zero downtime.
talents: Affliction: Improved Corruption, then Suppression; Unholy Power and Demonic Energies around 20; Improved Drains and Amplify Curse before 30; finish Affliction by 60.
rotation: Life Tap when health is higher than mana
keyGear: Staff or Orb of Soran'ruk: Warlock quest (fragments from Blackfathom Deeps and Shadowfang Keep)
Staff of the Shade: Razorfen Kraul (22+)
Gravestone Scepter: Blackfathom Villainy quest
Lesser / Greater Magic Wand: Enchanting
Shadow damage gear: Tailoring
tips: Fear a second mob while DoTs work on the first
Each Well Fed buff gives +5% kill XP
Keep a Healthstone
Never Curse of Recklessness a mob you plan to Fear

name: Druid levelling
summary: Feral cat is the smoothest route: early tools, Prowl and Dash, and little downtime for mana or healing.
talents: Feral via the source's calculator build (skipping Shredding Attacks); later move Furor or bear points into DPS talents for dungeons.
rotation: Thorns up; Faerie Fire to pull
Ferocious Bite at 4-5 points with 70+ Energy
keyGear: Idol of Shifting Tides: Aquatic Form class quest
Wolfshead Helm: Leatherworking
Manual Crowd Pummeler: Gnomeregan
Embrace of the Viper set: Wailing Caverns
Polearms: trainable from level 20
tips: Use Innervate and Barkskin freely in the open world
Travel Form at 30, Teleport: Moonglade at 10
Drop out of form to heal or break roots
